verdict.rationale: Modal's own Python SDK lets users deploy applications and programmatically interact with the platform, and the official CLI handles tasks such as creating Environments and targeting them with `--env`. However, nothing documents that every UI action has an API equivalent: the JS and Go SDKs cover only some platform resources, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/UI parity, evidence that dashboard-only settings (e.g., workspace budgets) are programmable, a public REST/OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
